name: Bromley-by-Bow gasworks
source: Author-supplied london_buildings_1891-96_corr_v1.gpkg (project extract west-ham-buffer-buildings-bng.geojson.gz); cached NLS OS London five-foot VIII.42, revised 1893
sourceCRS: EPSG:27700 to scene origin E538900,N183209; x east, z south, metres
method: Bromley gasworks 3 October 2026: OS-led audit of the 1891-96 footprints without models. Long purifier-block sheds, the lodge at B.M. 18.45, the south-west leg of the riverside L-range and small yard and garden buildings added from source outlines; purifier vessel rows refitted to the 44 mapped vessels; scrubber tanks and holders 1-4 moved to circle fits of the mapped column bases. Heights, storeys and roof forms are explicit estimates: the OS gives plan only, no Goad sheet covers the site and no photograph of the works buildings has been found. Later pass (T9, same day): the two retort-house envelopes (site924-os-13, -14) re-registered to their one-to-one source outlines (fids 49, 46; heights and roofs kept), their 24 interpretive roof flues carried across at the same fractional place in each block, and the boiler stack fitted to its mapped square base (fid 926100). Supplied outlines are used unshifted; at this site they sit 1.70 m west and 0.40 m south of the printed OS lines.
evidenceNotes: Most of the remaining mapped area at this site is plant (purifier vessels, holder column bases, an overhead coal gantry), not buildings; see reference/photo-review-2026-10-03/reports/site-924-proposal.md (local).
Holder bromley-9 is drawn on the 1893 OS with its 24 column bases; it does not post-date the survey.

buildings.review: T9 re-registration, 3 October 2026. MAPPED: the exterior is GeoPackage outline fid 49 (one-to-one, no holes), simplified at 0.15 m (max deviation 0.15 m), used unshifted like the other Bromley outlines; checked against the cached NLS five-foot VIII.42 mosaic, where this outline and 19 neighbouring site-924 outlines all sit 1.6-1.8 m west and 0.25-0.45 m south of the printed lines (median 1.70 m W, 0.40 m S). additionalBuildings.name: Bromley eastern purifier block — west, beside the scrubber enclosure shed
additionalBuildings.footprintEvidence: Source outline from the author's 1891–96 OS building GeoPackage (sourceFids 5993), merged across OS internal division lines where listed and simplified at 0.15 m; checked against the cached NLS five-foot 1893 mosaic. Long roofed (shaded) range set between parallel rows of rectangular purifier vessels in the eastern purifier block; OS five-foot plan, London VIII.42, revised 1893; OS internal notches along the long walls (pipe or valve connections) are kept in the outline.
additionalBuildings.heightEvidence: Explicit estimate; no measured height, storey mark or photograph of this building at c1900 is available. Single tall storey kept above the c2 m purifier vessels either side; 5.0 m eaves chosen for realism, not evidence.
additionalBuildings.roofEvidence: Pitched roof along the range is an interpretation. Sheds serving purifiers were usually ventilated; a ridge ventilator would be appropriate but the renderer has no ventilator option, so a plain gable is proposed. Slate/iron covering not established.
additionalBuildings.functionEvidence: Covered shed between purifier rows; probably lime/oxide store or revivifying floor, possibly also housing valves. Function is an interpretation from layout; no label on the OS.
